question: The Central Office of the Reserve Bank of India was initially established in which present city in 1935 ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Central Office of the Reserve Bank of India was initially established in **Kolkata** in 1935.
 
• It was later moved to **Mumbai** in 1937.
 
• The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is India's central banking institution, which controls the issuance and supply of the Indian rupee.
 
• It commenced operations on **1st April 1935** during the British Rule in accordance with the provisions of the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Reserve Bank of India was conceptualized based on the recommendations of the Hilton Young Commission.
 
• It plays a crucial role in the development strategy of the government of India.
 
• The RBI is responsible for regulating the monetary policy of the Indian rupee and ensuring the country's financial stability.
 
• It also manages the country's main payment systems and works to promote its economic development.
 
• The headquarters of the RBI is currently located in Mumbai, Maharashtra.
